versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch Log Config Generator.

- Generates a single log collection configuration file for Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch or self-managed Elasticsearch.
- Supports OpenTelemetry Collector (otelcol-contrib) and Elastic Beats / Filebeat as technology stacks.
- Handles log inputs from files, HTTP/webhook (OTLP), or Kafka topics.
- Enforces strict constraints: never mixes stacks, outputs only to Elasticsearch, and never inlines secrets.
- References comprehensive local documentation for each supported component and feature.
